post.originalText:
Gemini 4 argon vs Opus 5.5 head on against the same prompt:

"create an interactive terrarium in html for an ant civilisation"

opus 5.5 went deeper on the simulation. ants dig chambers and pile the soil into a mound, nurses carry eggs to a brood chamber, foragers lay scent trails, there's day/night and rain, plus a full colony ledger tracking population and food.

gemini 4 argon built the cleaner game. predator beetles, soldier ants, auto-forage, a polished HUD.

honestly opus 5.5 still feels better content wise. but gemini 4 argon is not bad at all. for what it costs, it's an insane model.

if you were building with one of these, would you pay for the depth or take the cheaper one?
